name: Etched
description: Etched is privately held and has no ticker. Review its funding rounds and valuations, the investors and SPVs that hold its shares, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: Etched is a privately held semiconductor company. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the valuations at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent financing, a $700 million Series D round announced on August 18, 2026, valued the company at $21 billion.

Founded in 2022 and based in San Jose, California, Etched develops inference hardware designed specifically for transformer-based AI models. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions, frequently through special purpose vehicles, and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.
figs: Special purpose vehicles with SEC filings naming Etched
table_note: Valuations are as reported at the time of each round.
round_notes: The Series D was led by Jane Street, which the company has identified as the first customer to receive one of its systems. It followed the Series C by less than a month. In June 2026, Etched said it had booked more than $1 billion in contracts ahead of its first shipments; that figure is the company's own.

A round valuation reflects the terms of the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: The Series D was led by Jane Street, with participation from Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia Capital, Andreessen Horowitz, Tiger Global and Bain Capital Ventures. Sequoia Capital led the Series C, joined by Andreessen Horowitz, Jane Street and SK Hynix. Earlier investors include Primary Venture Partners, Positive Sum and Peter Thiel.
spv_sentence: Since 2024, 11 special purpose vehicles formed to invest in Etched have filed with the SEC, eight of them in 2026.
sources: Sources: Etched's Series C announcement; SiliconANGLE reports dated August 18, 2026 and July 23, 2026; an eWeek report on the company's contracts; reporting by Reuters, Bloomberg and TechCrunch; and SEC Form D filings.
